ComponentwiseRUPSearch:
∀ (gen : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hg : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) gen),
    let part := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (x : ℕ) => φ.filter (fun c =>
      @decide (∃ m ∈ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b : ℕ =>
        ∃ d ∈ φ, a ∈ d.map Prod.fst ∧ b ∈ d.map Prod.fst) x m.1) (Classical.propDecidable _))
    let valid := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (w : List Bool) =>
      w.length ≤ 2*(PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length+6 ∧ ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = w ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d}
          (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) ∧ [] ∈ ρ
    ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
        (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) ≠ [] → valid φ (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ))) ∧
        ((∀ l : PEqualNP.Search.Literal, ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, l :: c ∈ φ → ¬ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (part φ l.1) →
          valid (part φ l.1) (gen (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (part φ l.1)))) →
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = [] ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ))
HybridComponentRUPSearch:
let part := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (x : ℕ) => φ.filter (fun c =>
      @decide (∃ m ∈ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b : ℕ =>
        ∃ d ∈ φ, a ∈ d.map Prod.fst ∧ b ∈ d.map Prod.fst) x m.1) (Classical.propDecidable _))
    let valid := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (w : List Bool) =>
      w.length ≤ 2*(PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length+6 ∧ ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = w ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d}
          (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) ∧ [] ∈ ρ
    ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) ≠ [] → valid φ (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ))) ∧
        ((∀ c ∈ φ, ∀ l ∈ c,
          let p := part φ l.1
          PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 p ∨ ∃ r : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ d ∈ p,
            ((d.map (fun m => (m.1,xor m.2 (r m.1)))).filter (fun m => m.2)).length ≤ 1) →
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = [] ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ) ∧
            (¬PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → valid φ (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ))))
ExactRUPRefutationVerifier:
PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair
      {p : List Bool × List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = p.2 ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) ∧
        [] ∈ ρ} ∧
    (∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
      PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) →
      [] ∈ ρ → ¬PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
MeasuredTwoSATRUPSearch:
∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 φ →
        (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = [] ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ) ∧
        (¬PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ ∧ ρ.length ≤ 3 ∧
          (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ).length ≤ 2*(PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length+6 ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) ∧ [] ∈ ρ)
MeasuredRenamableHornRUPSearch:
∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∃ r : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ c ∈ φ,
        ((c.map (fun l => (l.1,xor l.2 (r l.1)))).filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1) →
        (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = [] ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ) ∧
        (¬PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF [[]] ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (([[]] : PEqualNP.Search.CNF).map List.toFinset))
